name: Julian Pilois
story: At the 2018 New Zealand Esri User Conference, Julian Pilois presented “Beneath the Eagle’s Wing”; in 2019, he presented a two-part update on ArcGIS Online. Those sessions covered new capabilities in mapping, web applications, 3D, data management and administration for New Zealand practitioners.
